info.title: Fomo API
info.description: Public Fomo profiles, thesis history, leaderboards and live theses, powered by PooTracker. No API key, account or Fomo login is required. All paths share a rolling limit of 1,000 requests per IP per five minutes. Stored coverage is partial; PNL uses indexed Fomo swaps.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in this IP window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the oldest accepted request leaves the window

X-Cache-Status.description: YES for a profile served within its one-second cache window; NO when Fomo was fetched. Theses always fetch Fomo.

429.description: The shared IP limit was reached. Wait Retry-After seconds before retrying.

get.description: Connect over WebSocket, then send {"type":"subscribe","subscription":{"type":"all"}}. No API key. Connections start unsubscribed. The HTTP handshake counts toward the shared IP request limit. Reconnect, resubscribe, and reconcile missed events with the REST feed. Every outgoing JSON frame includes sentAtMs (Unix milliseconds). Thesis frames also include thesisCreatedAt (Unix milliseconds); data.fomoCreatedAt is retained.

Search public handles and display names in the local index. Exact handle matches come first. This is a literal substring search, not a complete directory of every Fomo account. Returns at most limit results.
